_parity_status.verdict: NOT AN EVAL CORPUS. Never use it as one.
_parity_status.detail: 201 of the 4 729 records are in parity TRAIN physicalai-train-e438721ae894. Only 257 have w120 video built, so the buildable eval split TODAY is 257 clips of which 201 = 78.21 % are train (REF-A-I-JEPA scale). Separately 6 of the 40 canonical val episodes (15.0 %) sit inside the Alpamayo record set. Blast radius on published numbers: ZERO.
_parity_status.consequence_here: A VOCABULARY-DESIGN measurement is not an eval -- nothing here scores a model, so contamination does not invalidate these coverage numbers. It DOES forbid Alpamayo meta-actions as held-out tactical labels, and the remaining 4 472-clip build must call parity.filter_train_clips() first.

SPEED_LIMIT_intent_is_a_FORBIDDEN_CHANNE.detail: 41 CoT phrases read a speed-limit sign's TEXT ('a 120 speed limit sign is posted ahead', 'a 35 mph speed limit sign sets the target speed'). `stack/tanitad/models/v6.py:188-200` records the F-14 blocker: sign KIND and TEXT are FORBIDDEN (RETRACTION_LOG C87) and the G1 sign-text gate is CLOSED at 0/31. Taking `v_hi` from an Alpamayo phrase is the SAME forbidden fact arriving through a teacher model.
SPEED_LIMIT_intent_is_a_FORBIDDEN_CHANNE.worse: the same v6.py cell records that the two highest-scoring FALSE positives of the sign channel are a DASHBOARD `30` ROUNDEL (0.927) and a hoarding (0.778) -- a dashboard roundel is the EGO SPEEDOMETER, so a sign-derived target speed can be an EGO ECHO arriving through the vision channel. A VLM reading the same pixels inherits the same failure.
SPEED_LIMIT_intent_is_a_FORBIDDEN_CHANNE.verdict: SPEED_LIMIT is the ONE intent whose numeric arg the phrase determines, and it is INADMISSIBLE for that very reason. It is counted in coverage as a GOAL (SPEED_BAND is groundable from other evidence) but its `v_hi` arg must be DISCARDED.

Whether those are real sub-lane evasions the axis fails to encode, or CoT embellishment, is UNADJUDICATED -- and it is a larger label swing than the TURN question (3.94 %) by 4.3x.

Maintain Speed.rationale: hold current speed; `v` NOT in the phrase -- recoverable from ego v(t0) in hindsight (labels-may-use-ego), never from the phrase

Gentle Acceleration.rationale: target-speed increase. Our LON set is TARGET-typed and Alpamayo's is RATE-typed, so `v` is unrecoverable from the phrase; only the sign+severity band transfers

Strong Acceleration.rationale: as Gentle Acceleration. The gentle/strong distinction has NO slot in our LON vocabulary and is LOST

Gentle Deceleration.rationale: speed reduction; neither `v` nor `within_m` is in the phrase; gentle/strong has no slot and is LOST

Stop.rationale: come to / remain at rest = HOLD; the approach is BRAKE_TO(0, within_m) and `within_m` is NOT determined by the phrase

Lane Keep.rationale: identical semantics; LANE_KEEP takes no args so nothing is lost

Left Lane Change.rationale: identical semantics; `within_m` NOT determined by the phrase

Right Lane Change.rationale: identical semantics; `within_m` NOT determined by the phrase

Slightly Shift Left.rationale: sub-lane lateral offset = NUDGE by construction; `lat_m` NOT determined (Alpamayo has no magnitude slot)

Slightly Shift Right.rationale: sub-lane lateral offset = NUDGE; `lat_m` NOT determined

Turn Left.rationale: v6.0 reading: a junction turn is not a lane change -- the ego holds its corridor while the corridor turns, so LAT = LANE_KEEP and the turn is g_str:TURN_LEFT. v6.1 maps it to TURN_L instead (see LANE2LAT_V61); this is a live PI decision, not a settled fact

Turn Right.rationale: as Turn Left; v6.1 maps it to TURN_R

Lane Keep.rationale: identical semantics; LANE_KEEP takes no args so nothing is lost

Left Lane Change.rationale: identical semantics; `within_m` NOT determined by the phrase

Right Lane Change.rationale: identical semantics; `within_m` NOT determined by the phrase

Slightly Shift Left.rationale: sub-lane lateral offset = NUDGE by construction; `lat_m` NOT determined (Alpamayo has no magnitude slot)

Slightly Shift Right.rationale: sub-lane lateral offset = NUDGE; `lat_m` NOT determined

Turn Left.rationale: v6.1 junction-traversal token; route-conditioned, and REPRESENTABLE BUT NOT SCOREABLE at n=85 (v6.py:262-266)

Turn Right.rationale: v6.1 junction-traversal token; n=101, not scoreable

channel1_mapping._version_note: The two tables differ ONLY on `Turn Left`/`Turn Right` (186 rows, 3.94 %). Instance coverage is IDENTICAL at 93.57 % either way -- the choice is about whether a junction traversal is representable AS ITSELF or only as LANE_KEEP + a strategic goal. It changes no coverage number and it is a PI decision.

channel1_UNMAPPED.reverse_adjudication: `Reverse` / `Reverse Left` / `Reverse Right` are adjudicated DECODE ARTEFACTS, not a vocabulary gap. Evidence: all 6 `Longitudinal: Reverse` rows carry a FORWARD-driving CoT ('Keep lane to continue driving since the path ahead is clear', 'Slow down for the right curve ahead'), and both `Reverse *` LATERAL rows fall on the SAME 2 clips as a `Longitudinal: Reverse`. Sampling is temperature 0.6, so a 0.13 % / 0.04 % tail is consistent with decode noise. => do NOT add a REVERSE token on this evidence. They are still COUNTED as UNMAPPED so the number is visible, not assumed away.

LON.FOLLOW(time_gap_s): no Longitudinal value expresses car-following; recoverable ONLY from the CoT (intent FOLLOW_LEAD, 20.28 % of instances)
LON.YIELD/MERGE(gap_slot): no Longitudinal value expresses yielding; recoverable ONLY from the CoT (YIELD_* intents, 10.25 % of instances)
LON.CREEP: no Alpamayo value at all, in either channel

LAT.ABORT_LC: 0 instances in either channel. A single-frame declaration cannot express an abort, which is defined by a CHANGE of a previous decision

stop_absorption_finding.note: `Longitudinal: Stop` TERMINATES the declaration -- Lateral and Lane are not emitted at all (the generation ends `Stop.<|traj_future_start|>`). Not a parse failure. Consequence for a FACTORED LAT x LON head: on 6.43 % of instances the corpus supplies NO lateral token, so LAT must abstain or be imputed from hindsight geometry. It is also why the FACTORED-PAIR coverage is capped at 93.44 % no matter how good the mapping is.

channel2_coverage._definition: instance-weighted over the same 4 729 rows' CoT strings; rules are ORDERED and FIRST MATCH WINS, so per-intent counts are first-match counts, not concept-occurrence counts

RESUME_AFTER_CLEAR.rationale: the RELEASE of a yield/stop once the blocker clears. `RESUME_CRUISE` exists at the STRATEGIC layer (a_str); there is no tactical 'release' token, so the tactical read is a SPEED_BAND change. `v_target` is never numeric in the phrase

FOLLOW_LEAD.rationale: the lead agent is named; `agent_slot_id` needs the PERCEPTION-AGENTS head and `time_gap_s` the LEAD-STATE head -- the phrase determines neither

TRAFFIC_LIGHT.rationale: `state` IS determined by the phrase (red/yellow/green literal); `light_slot_id` and `stopline_arc_m` are not

YIELD_SIGN.rationale: yield point named; neither arc nor gap slot is

YIELD_VRU.rationale: VRU yield. `gap_slot` IS groundable -- obstacle.offline's 10 dynamic classes include pedestrians/cyclists -- but the arc is not

YIELD_TRAFFIC.rationale: yield to a vehicle; slot groundable via obstacle.offline, arc not

GAP_ACCEPT.rationale: `dir` determined where the phrase names a side; the gap slot and time gap are not

OVERTAKE.rationale: OVERTAKE has no single token: it decomposes into a LAT lane change plus a LON speed band, which is exactly what the factored scheme is for. No `OVERTAKE` token is needed or proposed

LANE_CHANGE.rationale: `dir` determined where a side is named; `within_m` never

EVADE_DYNAMIC.rationale: exactly the token's stated use-case; `obstacle_slot` IS groundable for these DYNAMIC classes via obstacle.offline

EVADE_STATIC_FURNITURE.rationale: GROUNDING GAP, not a vocabulary gap. The token fits, but `obstacle_slot` has NO supplier: obstacle.offline's enum over 87 481 cuboids is 10 classes, ALL DYNAMIC AGENTS (CLAUDE.md), so static roadside furniture has nothing to point at. Engine C (SAM) is the candidate supplier

EVADE_OTHER.rationale: residual nudge whose object no earlier rule classified

WAIT_ONCOMING.rationale: the token's stated use-case (narrow-road / parked-lane pinch negotiation). Requires an explicit WAIT/HOLD/UNTIL or a NARROWS reference -- a bare mention of oncoming traffic is an evasion or a corridor observation, not a negotiated wait

FORK_SPLIT.rationale: A FORK IS NOT A LANE CHANGE: the ego holds its lane and the LANE diverges, so LAT stays LANE_KEEP and the choice is strategic. `dir` determined; distances not. Note many of these phrases cite OVERHEAD SIGNAGE, which our vocabulary can only read through the G1-gated OCR path (g_str:ROUTE_TO)

JUNCTION_TURN.rationale: direction determined; the intersection arc is not

ROUNDABOUT.rationale: roundabout entry = a yield point; the EXIT taken is a strategic choice the phrase usually does not state

INTERSECTION_APPROACH.rationale: uncontrolled approach to a junction with no light/sign named

SPEED_FOR_CURVE.rationale: curvature-driven speed target; no numeric band in the phrase

SPEED_LIMIT.rationale: the ONE intent where a numeric arg is sometimes literally in the phrase ('a 120 speed limit sign is posted ahead')

SPEED_FOR_FEATURE.rationale: road-feature / obstruction speed adaptation; no numeric band in the phrase

CORRIDOR_DEFAULT.rationale: the PI's stated no-route default (2026-08-11). It IS a real token and a real mapping, but it is the NULL hypothesis, so it is reported as its own tier and never folded into the headline coverage

ACTION_ONLY_NO_REFERENT.rationale: determines an a_tac LON ACTION but names NO referent => NO goal token is determinable. Counted as GOAL-UNMAPPED, not as coverage

channel2_UNMAPPED._definition: tiers `action_only` (an a_tac ACTION is determined but NO goal token is) and `unmapped` (nothing matched). LOGGED IN FULL.

why_LAT_comes_from_the_Lane_axis_not_the._definition: row-normalised % of the `Lateral` axis within each `Lane` value
why_LAT_comes_from_the_Lane_axis_not_the.finding: If `Lateral` were a proxy for lane topology each row would concentrate in one column. It does not. A JUNCTION TURN is 80-81 % `Sharp Steer *` (large curvature) while a LANE CHANGE is ~60 % `Go Straight` -- i.e. ON THE `Lateral` AXIS A LANE CHANGE IS INDISTINGUISHABLE FROM A LANE KEEP. `Lateral` measures CURVATURE MAGNITUDE; `Lane` measures LANE TOPOLOGY. Our `a_tac` LAT axis is topological, so it must be mapped from `Lane`.
why_LAT_comes_from_the_Lane_axis_not_the.corroborates: the 2026-08-05 `a2_parse_meta_action.py` LAT2DIR projection scored agreement 0.4706 / kappa 0.1488 against the driven path on n=34 -- it projected our direction classes onto the `Lateral` axis, which is the wrong axis. The low agreement was a category error, not a model failure.

joint_LON_resolution._why: The prior screening (.../2026-08-18-alpamayo-screening/ALPAMAYO_SCREENING_AND_VOCAB_REVIEW.md Sec.2.1) established that our LON vocabulary is REASON-TYPED and Alpamayo's Longitudinal axis is MAGNITUDE-TYPED, so the axis alone cannot pick a LON token. RE-VERIFIED AND CONFIRMED here. The reason, however, IS in the record -- it is the chain-of-causation -- so the LON token is determined by the PAIR.
joint_LON_resolution.note: CREEP is produced by no (axis, intent) pair -- it has no Alpamayo source at all. The 6 unresolved are the `Reverse` decode artefacts.

gtac_goal_axis_supply._why: v6.py factors the GOAL vocabulary too (TACTICAL_GOAL_TOKENS_LAT/LON, 2026-08-16). This is which axis the corpus actually supplies goal evidence FOR.
gtac_goal_axis_supply.finding: The LAT goal axis is nearly unsupplied. Alpamayo's CoT grounds EVADE_IN_CORRIDOR and nothing else on LAT: ANCHOR_GOAL and CORRIDOR_OFFSET -- the two remaining LAT goal tokens, and ANCHOR_GOAL is the '+4.7 PDMS' geometric-goal lever -- have NO Alpamayo source in either channel. They are geometry-derived by construction, so this is expected, but it means Alpamayo cannot supervise the LAT goal head at all.

rule_robustness.note: ordering sensitivity: this many `specific` instances would fall to CORRIDOR_DEFAULT if the default rule were moved first. The headline coverage is stable to within this band.
rule_robustness.multi_label_note: phrases matching >1 SPECIFIC rule. Real: 'slow down for the roundabout because of the yield sign' is genuinely a YIELD_AT and a roundabout. First-match assigns one; a production tokenizer should emit a SET.

channel_disagreement._definition: rows where BOTH the CoT and the `Lane` axis assert a LAT class
channel_disagreement.note: ONE decode produced both, so this is INTERNAL INCONSISTENCY of the generation, not inter-annotator disagreement. Any supervised use must declare which channel it reads. The dominant cell is cot=NUDGE|axis=LANE_KEEP: the CoT reports a sub-lane evasion the `Lane` axis does not encode.
